MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

3. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.

7. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.

8. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.

9. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

10. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.

11. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.

12. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Post- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
